title: Dinosaur Advent Calendar – 24 Dinosaurs
seo_description: December gets a fixed morning routine all the way to Christmas Eve.
descriptionHtml:
The chocolate calendar is empty before breakfast

Every December it's the same story: the calendar is opened in a rush, the chocolate is eaten before the shoes are on, and there's nothing left to look forward to for the rest of the day. A child who is completely into dinosaurs wants something concrete to open every morning — not a piece of chocolate that disappears in ten seconds.

Filled with 24 dinosaurs, one per day

This calendar comes pre-filled: 24 numbered doors, a small dinosaur behind each one. Nothing extra to buy and nothing to pack in advance — open the box and December 1 is ready to go. The figures are in random order, so the surprise lasts all the way to Christmas Eve.

What you get

  • December gets a fixed morning routine all the way to Christmas Eve.
  • A new dinosaur figure to play with every day, which lives on in the toy box after Christmas.
  • The Christmas present is sorted and ready to give straight from the box.
  • The surprise lasts the whole month because the figures come in random order.
  • Cardboard box with 24 numbered doors, one for each day until Christmas Eve.
  • 24 plastic dinosaur figures, one behind each door.
  • The figures are randomly distributed (blind box).
  • Christmas print on the box: T-rex in a Santa hat, triceratops and pterosaur.
  • Age rating 3+ printed on the box.
  • According to the supplier, the figures glow in the dark after being charged in light — a claim from the supplier, not verified by us.

Frequently asked questions

What age is the calendar for?
The age rating 3+ is printed on the box. The calendar is not intended for children under 3 years.

Do I know in advance which dinosaur is behind each door?
No, the figures are randomly distributed — that's the surprise. We can't confirm whether all 24 are different species or whether some repeat.

Do the figures really glow in the dark?
The supplier states that they do after being charged in light. We have no image of our own showing them in the dark, so we can't confirm it ourselves.

How big are the figures and the box?
The supplier gives no dimensions or weight, so unfortunately we can't state exact measurements right now.

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
